sentiment_score_definition: x <= -0.35: Bearish; -0.35 < x <= -0.15: Somewhat-Bearish; -0.15 < x < 0.15: Neutral; 0.15 <= x < 0.35: Somewhat_Bullish; x >= 0.35: Bullish
relevance_score_definition: 0 < x <= 1, with a higher score indicating higher relevance.

feed.title: Monster Beverage stock holds firm as Q2 2026 growth and new labelling rules shape outlook
feed.summary: Monster Beverage stock is trading steadily in the high-$40 range, supported by robust Q2 2026 revenue growth of 20.4% year-over-year and a low debt profile. The company faces new regulatory challenges in India regarding energy drink labeling, which may require product rebranding. Despite a high price-to-earnings multiple of 44.2x, analysts maintain a positive outlook, anticipating continued strong growth to justify its valuation.

feed.title: Lineage misses another warehouse cleanup deadline, fueling frustration in Boyle Heights
feed.summary: Lineage Logistics missed yet another deadline for cleaning up its fire-damaged Boyle Heights warehouse, causing renewed frustration among residents. Locals report persistent foul odors from rotting food, leading to health concerns, increased electricity bills, and the displacement of family members. Los Angeles Mayor Karen Bass has expressed her dissatisfaction with the company's shifting timelines.

feed.title: Strong Starbucks stock holds just below consensus target as FY 2026 guidance underpins earnings outl
feed.summary: Starbucks stock is trading at $103.99, below the average analyst target of $110.30, but its FY 2026 EPS guidance of $2.55 to $2.65 aligns closely with analyst forecasts of $2.64. The company's premium valuation and 23% year-to-date gain hinge on meeting this guidance, especially given competitive pressures in key markets like China. Institutional interest remains steady, supporting a consensus "Hold" rating.

feed.title: Morgan Stanley raises Beike stock price target on market share gains
feed.summary: Morgan Stanley has increased its price target for Beike (NYSE:BEKE) to $23.00 from $22.00, maintaining an Overweight rating. This adjustment reflects Beike's continuous market share gains and strong Q2 2026 earnings, despite uncertainties in China's property market. The firm highlighted Beike's improving operational efficiency and management's aggressive share buybacks as indicators of confidence in the company's long-term prospects.

feed.title: Medifast director Parsa Kiai acquires $842,698 in company shares By Investing.com
feed.summary: Medifast director Parsa Kiai indirectly acquired shares worth $842,698 on August 19 and 20, 2026, through investment entities he manages. The acquisitions occurred at average prices between $11.6037 and $11.6576 per share, with the company's stock currently trading at $11.95. Despite Medifast's impressive gross profit margins, it has not been profitable over the last twelve months, although it recently surpassed analyst expectations for Q2 2026 financial results.

feed.title: Liquidity Services to Present and Host 1x1 Investor Meetings at the 17th Annual Midwest IDEAS Investor Conference on August 26th in Chicago, IL
feed.summary: Liquidity Services, Inc. announced that its Co-Founder, Chairman, and CEO, Bill Angrick, will present at the 17th Annual Midwest IDEAS Investor Conference on August 26, 2026, in Chicago, IL. The presentation will be webcast and accessible via the conference and company investor relations websites. IDEAS Investor Conferences provide a platform for companies to present to investment professionals and are sponsored by investors.

feed.title: Cigna PAC Spreads $1.17M Across Bipartisan Congress
feed.summary: Cigna's employee Political Action Committee (PAC) distributed $1.17 million to various congressional campaigns in the first half of 2026, targeting a bipartisan group of recipients. The PAC, registered under FEC ID C00085316, reported $1.89 million in total receipts and $1.96 million in disbursements. While supporters highlight the voluntary nature of contributions and Cigna's transparency, critics argue that corporate PAC spending allows companies to influence policy for commercial gain, potentially at the expense of public interest, particularly in the healthcare sector.

feed.title: Ross Stores earnings, sales soar in Q2; 115 new stores planned in 2026
feed.summary: Ross Stores reported exceptional Q2 fiscal 2026 results, surpassing Wall Street expectations with earnings per share of $2.66 and sales of $6.26 billion, a 13% year-over-year increase. The off-price retailer also announced an increase in its store opening plans for 2026, targeting 115 new locations, and provided optimistic guidance for the remainder of the fiscal year. The strong performance was attributed to compelling merchandise, engaging marketing, and an enhanced in-store experience, leading to increased customer traffic and engagement.

feed.title: Morgan Stanley Issues Pessimistic Forecast for Sempra Energy (NYSE:SRE) Stock Price
feed.summary: Morgan Stanley lowered its price target for Sempra Energy (NYSE:SRE) from $108 to $104 but maintained an "overweight" rating, implying a potential upside of 23.59%. Despite beating earnings estimates, Sempra Energy's revenue fell below expectations, and its stock price dropped by 3.7% to $84.15. The company currently holds a "Moderate Buy" consensus rating from analysts, with a target price of $103.62.

feed.title: EIX Maintained by Morgan Stanley -- Price Target Lowered to $65.
feed.summary: Morgan Stanley has maintained an Underweight rating for Edison International (EIX), lowering its price target from $69.00 to $65.00, reflecting a cautious outlook for the utility company. Despite a slight undervaluation according to GF Value™, concerns remain regarding EIX's negative cash flow and low financial strength score, prompting investors to consider these factors alongside the analyst's updated rating.

feed.title: Yum! Brands Appoints Former HanesBrands CEO Steve Bratspies to Board of Directors
feed.summary: Yum! Brands, Inc. announced the appointment of Stephen "Steve" B. Bratspies, former CEO of HanesBrands, Inc., to its Board of Directors, effective August 26, 2026. Bratspies brings extensive experience in leading global consumer brands, driving operational excellence, and public company leadership from his roles at HanesBrands, Walmart Inc., Specialty Brands, PepsiCo, Inc., Target Corporation, and The Clorox Company. His expertise is expected to be a valuable asset in advancing Yum! Brands' "Raise the B.A.R." priorities and creating long-term stakeholder value.

feed.title: Detroit's top legal officer faces ethics probe for Lear role
feed.summary: Detroit's Corporation Counsel, Conrad Mallett Jr., is under investigation by the city's Board of Ethics regarding his $335,000 board position at Lear Corp., an auto supplier that received a significant tax incentive while Mallett was Deputy Mayor. The probe also examines whether he properly disclosed this role and his son's employment with the city. Mallett maintains he disclosed the information and was not involved in the Lear deal, expressing confidence in his ethical conduct.

feed.title: Insulet Corporation (PODD) Shareholders Who Lost Money Have Opportunity to Lead Securities Fraud Lawsuit
feed.summary: The Law Offices of Frank R. Cruz announce that Insulet Corporation (PODD) shareholders who suffered losses have an opportunity to lead a securities fraud class action lawsuit. The lawsuit alleges that Insulet made materially false and misleading statements between February 21, 2025, and May 26, 2026, by failing to disclose defective manufacturing controls that created a heightened risk of product safety violations. Investors are encouraged to participate before the August 31, 2026, lead plaintiff deadline.

feed.title: Smucker To Promote Jeff Varcoe to SVP of Science and Technical Excellence
feed.summary: J.M. Smucker Co. will promote Jeff Varcoe to Senior Vice President of Science and Technical Excellence, effective August 24. Varcoe has served as Vice President of Quality Assurance and Food Safety since 2023 and brings over 25 years of experience in the food industry to his new role. He previously spent 21 years at Schwan Food Co. in various leadership positions.

feed.title: Moody’s changes ARKO outlook to stable on debt reduction
feed.summary: Moody's has revised ARKO Corp.'s outlook from negative to stable, while affirming its B2 corporate family rating and other related ratings. This upgrade is attributed to ARKO's improved credit metrics, which resulted from significant debt reduction and increased earnings in the first half of 2026, including proceeds from a partial IPO of ARKO Petroleum Corp. The company's adjusted debt to EBITDA ratio and EBITA coverage of interest have both improved, and Moody's anticipates ARKO will maintain strong liquidity despite a challenging consumer environment.

feed.title: Arista Networks (ANET) Stock May Be Fully Priced On Its 7x Five Year Run
feed.summary: Arista Networks (ANET) has seen a significant 7x return over the past five years, leading to a current valuation that appears mixed. While its Discounted Cash Flow (DCF) model suggests the stock is fairly valued near its current price, earnings-based multiples indicate it might be overvalued compared to the broader communications industry. The article highlights that the stock's strong performance puts pressure on future growth and profitability, especially given its reliance on large cloud and AI customers.

feed.title: Developing World-Class Hospitality Talent: Sands China Introduces Four Elite Training Programs
feed.summary: Sands China has launched four new elite talent development programs to enhance hospitality training in Macao, focusing on hotel operations, guest services, culinary arts, and transportation. These initiatives aim to strengthen the company's talent pipeline, promote upward mobility, and support Macao's goal of becoming a global tourism hub by cultivating local talent with international perspectives. The programs include specialized training, overseas exposure, and collaboration with academic institutions, building on Sands China's existing comprehensive talent development platform.

feed.title: Pentair plc (PNR) Shareholders Who Lost Money Have Opportunity to Lead Securities Fraud Lawsuit
feed.summary: The Law Offices of Frank R. Cruz announced that shareholders of Pentair plc (PNR) who incurred losses between March 11, 2026, and July 14, 2026, have the opportunity to lead a securities fraud class action lawsuit. The lawsuit alleges that Pentair failed to disclose significant inventory destocking in its Pool channel, which negatively impacted the company's sales and operating income. Investors are encouraged to contact the law firm before the October 2, 2026, lead plaintiff deadline.

feed.title: Broadcom, BMC And IBM Top Gartner’s List For Best Automation And Orchestration Platforms Of 2026
feed.summary: Gartner's 2026 Magic Quadrant for Service Orchestration And Automation Platforms identifies seven leading companies in automation and orchestration. Broadcom, BMC, Beta Systems Software, HCLSoftware, IBM, Stonebranch, and Redwood Software are highlighted for unifying workload automation, workflow orchestration, and data pipelines across diverse architectures. The report also predicts a significant increase in the use of generative AI and AI agents in these platforms by 2029 and 2030, respectively, to enhance efficiency and automation.

feed.title: Walmart to begin rolling out tap-to-pay options at U.S. stores
feed.summary: Walmart is set to introduce tap-to-pay options at select U.S. stores and Sam's Club locations starting August 24, with a full nationwide rollout expected by the end of 2026. This new contactless payment method will allow customers to use eligible cards, phones, and smartwatches, complementing existing payment systems like cash, credit cards, and Walmart Pay. The service is also planned for fuel stations by mid-2027.

feed.title: CoStar Closes on $800 Million Zonda Acquisition
feed.summary: CoStar Group has finalized its $800 million acquisition of Zonda, a leading provider of new home construction data, software, and residential real estate marketplaces. This strategic move expands CoStar's presence in the residential real estate sector, integrating Zonda's proprietary lot-level database and online marketplaces like NewHomeSource.com and Livabl. CoStar aims to leverage this acquisition to accelerate innovation and deliver more value to the homebuilding industry, combining Zonda's capabilities with its existing market intelligence and technology.

feed.title: Coca-Cola (NYSE: KO) EVP sells 50K shares around $90 each
feed.summary: Nancy Quan, Executive Vice President of Coca-Cola (NYSE: KO), exercised 50,000 employee stock options at $50.4383 per share and subsequently sold all 50,000 common shares at a weighted average price of $90.3852 per share on August 19, 2026. This transaction resulted in approximate gross sale proceeds of $4.52 million and a pre-tax spread of about $2.00 million. Following the sale, Quan still holds 20,585 options directly, along with shares in Coca-Cola's 401(k) and supplemental 401(k) plans.

feed.title: Quest Diagnostics stock holds near highs after Q2 beat
feed.summary: Quest Diagnostics (DGX) stock is trading near its 52-week high after reporting strong Q2 2026 results, with revenue of $3.04 billion and EPS of $3.12, both exceeding estimates. The company's revenue growth of 10.2% year-over-year and narrow fiscal 2026 EPS guidance of $11.05-$11.25 support its firm valuation, with analysts maintaining a constructive outlook. The robust demand for its broad diagnostics network continues to drive its performance and stable earnings profile.

feed.title: Bunge to Present at Barclays Annual Global Consumer Conference
feed.summary: Bunge Global SA announced that its management will participate in a fireside chat at the 2026 Barclays Annual Global Consumer Conference on September 8, at 3:00 p.m. ET. Investors can listen to the live event via a webcast link on Bunge's website, where a transcript and replay will also be available for a limited time. The company is a premier agribusiness solutions provider, connecting farmers to consumers globally.

feed.title: In off price, Ross is the new boss
feed.summary: Ross Stores reported a significant surge in Q2 comparable sales, up 10% due to increased customer traffic, outperforming major rival TJX Cos. This strong performance is attributed to Ross's elevated merchandising, including more brand names and store revamps, as well as conservative pricing that resonates with value-focused consumers. The company expects continued growth and plans to expand its store count, indicating a potential shift in market share within the off-price retail sector.

feed.title: U.S. Bank says breach claims related to fourth-party incident
feed.summary: U.S. Bancorp confirmed that recent claims of data theft by the LockBit ransomware gang are linked to a breach involving a contractor for a third-party, not its own systems. The company stated there is no evidence of compromise to its networks or data repositories and has reported the incident to law enforcement. This comes after LockBit added U.S. Bancorp to its victim list, with the bank emphasizing that the breach originated from a "fourth-party event" outside their environment.

feed.title: IREN Clears Its Biggest AI Test With Microsoft
feed.summary: Data-center operator IREN Ltd. has successfully cleared a major AI hurdle as Microsoft Corp. officially approved Horizon 1, the first of four data centers under a five-year, $9.7 billion deal. This approval signifies a crucial step in IREN's AI buildout, allowing them to begin billing Microsoft and demonstrating their execution capabilities beyond Bitcoin mining. The site also achieved Exemplar Cloud status with Nvidia Corp. computers, further boosting confidence in its performance and reliability.

feed.title: Jupiter Neurosciences proposes selling 307,692 shares for about $2 million
feed.summary: Jupiter Neurosciences (NASDAQ: JUNS) announced a registered direct offering of 307,692 shares of common stock, aiming to raise approximately $2.0 million in gross proceeds. The offering is being conducted under an effective Form S-3 shelf registration statement, with D. Boral Capital LLC acting as the exclusive placement agent. The closing is anticipated around August 24, 2026, subject to customary conditions, and the market reacted positively to the news with JUNS stock gaining 43.52%.

feed.title: Jupiter Neurosciences Announces Pricing of $2.0 Million Registered Direct Offering
feed.summary: Jupiter Neurosciences, Inc. announced a registered direct offering of 307,692 shares of common stock, expecting to raise approximately $2.0 million in gross proceeds. The offering is anticipated to close on or about August 24, 2026, with D. Boral Capital LLC acting as the exclusive placement agent. The clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company focuses on central nervous system disorders and neuroinflammation.

feed.title: LCNB CORP (LCNB) fully places $25M private debt raise
feed.summary: LCNB CORP (LCNB) has successfully completed a private exempt offering, fully placing $25 million in debt securities under Regulation D, Rule 506(b). The Ohio commercial banking corporation reported its first sale on August 7, 2026, with no remaining amount to be sold. Brean Capital, LLC assisted in the sales process for the offering, which targets multiple U.S. states.

feed.title: Newmont Corporation Stock (NEM) Moved Up by 3.18% on Aug 21: What Signal Does It Send?
feed.summary: Newmont Corporation (NEM) stock increased by 3.18% on August 21, driven by strong spot gold prices, increased market demand, and favorable analyst commentary. The rally was fueled by lower long-term bond yields and a weaker U.S. Dollar Index, making gold more attractive, alongside positive company-specific fundamentals like strong operational margins and successful capital expansion projects. While technical indicators suggest strong momentum, potential risks include overbought conditions, insider share sales, and possible production guidance cuts.

feed.title: Here's How Much $1000 Invested In Eaton Corp 10 Years Ago Would Be Worth Today
feed.summary: This article analyzes the hypothetical return on a $1000 investment in Eaton Corp (NYSE: ETN) made 10 years ago. It reveals that such an investment would be worth $6,260.70 today, demonstrating the power of compounded returns. Eaton Corp has significantly outperformed the market over the past decade with an annualized return of 20.12%.

feed.title: Walmart to Offer Apple Pay in Push for Contactless Payments
feed.summary: Walmart is finally integrating Apple Pay into its payment options, marking a significant shift for the world's largest retailer. This move is part of a broader initiative to expand contactless payment choices across all Walmart stores, websites, and apps by the end of the year, aiming to enhance the shopping experience for customers.

feed.title: MCB Alert: HAGENS BERMAN, NATIONAL TRIAL ATTORNEYS, Encourages Metropolitan Bank Holding Corp. (NYSE: MCB) Investors with Significant Losses to Contact Firm
feed.summary: Hagens Berman, a national shareholder rights law firm, is investigating potential securities law violations by Metropolitan Bank Holding Corp. (NYSE: MCB) after disappointing Q2 financial results and unexpected credit quality disclosures led to a significant stock drop. The investigation focuses on whether the bank misled investors by downplaying credit issues as a "speed bump" while underlying risks in its C&I and legacy loan portfolios may have been more severe, contradicting earlier assurances of adequate reserves and full recovery on troubled assets. Investors with significant losses are encouraged to contact the firm.

feed.title: AbbVie (ABBV) Presented New Lung Cancer Clinical Data At WCLC 2026
feed.summary: AbbVie (ABBV) presented new clinical data at the 2026 World Conference on Lung Cancer (WCLC) for several lung cancer programs, including investigational therapies ABBV-1480, telisotuzumab adizutecan, and ABBV-706. These updates are crucial for AbbVie's strategy to diversify its portfolio beyond immunology and neuroscience into oncology. While the data shows promising objective response rates, the success of these unapproved agents and their safety profiles in larger trials will determine their commercial viability.

feed.title: After multimillion May sales, nLIGHT (LASR) insider plans new stock sale
feed.summary: An insider at nLIGHT, Inc. (LASR), Scott H. Keeney, has filed a Rule 144 notice to sell 181,750 shares of common stock, which he will acquire through a stock option exercise on August 21, 2026. This proposed sale follows several significant open-market sales by Keeney in May and June 2026, totaling over $8 million. The filing highlights both the planned future sale and past insider transactions, detailing the shares, values, and the broker involved.

feed.title: LSI Industries (NASDAQ:LYTS) Shares Down 4.1% Following Analyst Downgrade
feed.summary: LSI Industries (NASDAQ:LYTS) shares dropped 4.1% after Oppenheimer lowered its price target from $30 to $29, while still maintaining an "outperform" rating. Despite strong fiscal fourth-quarter growth with revenue up 51% and adjusted EPS exceeding estimates, GAAP EPS missed expectations, and full-year net income declined. The article also highlights significant insider selling activity, with executives selling shares worth millions in recent months.

feed.title: Bronstein, Gewirtz & Grossman LLC Urges Hub Group, Inc. Investors to Act: Class Action Filed Alleging Investor Harm
feed.summary: Bronstein, Gewirtz & Grossman LLC has filed a class action lawsuit against Hub Group, Inc. and its officers, alleging violations of federal securities laws. The lawsuit claims that Hub Group's financial statements from Q1 2023 to Q3 2025 contained material misstatements regarding revenue, income, and costs. Investors who purchased Hub Group securities between April 28, 2023, and May 11, 2026, are encouraged to join the lawsuit, with a lead plaintiff deadline of August 28, 2026.

feed.title: Union Pacific Merger Deal Gets Rail Regulator Review Timeline
feed.summary: The Surface Transportation Board has set an official timeline for its review of the proposed merger between Union Pacific Corp. and Norfolk Southern Corp., aiming for a final decision by summer 2027. This deal would create the first coast-to-coast rail network in the US, though the timeline allows for extensions. Union Pacific CEO Jim Vena had initially hoped to finalize the merger much sooner.

feed.title: Diamondback Energy stock trades close to record high as big institutions add exposure
feed.summary: Diamondback Energy (FANG) stock is trading near its all-time high in late August 2026, driven by significant institutional investment and strong analyst ratings. Recent regulatory filings reveal major asset managers increasing their stakes, reflecting confidence in the company's oil and natural gas portfolio. Analysts maintain an average 12-month price target in the low-to-mid-$220 range, slightly above the current trading levels, following the company's Q2 2026 earnings beat and positive guidance.

feed.title: Could Investing $300 a Month in VOO Make You a Millionaire? Here's the Math.
feed.summary: Investing $300 a month in the Vanguard S&P 500 ETF (VOO) could make you a millionaire, depending on the average annual returns. Historically, the S&P 500 has averaged 10% annual returns, but VOO has performed even better in recent years, averaging almost 15% over the past 15 years. Based on past performance, reaching millionaire status could take between 27 and 36 years with a consistent $300 monthly investment.

feed.title: Morgan Stanley course-corrects their semiconductor equipment outlook on demand
feed.summary: Morgan Stanley has revised its outlook for the semiconductor production equipment industry, noting that April-June results showed few positive catalysts except for Advantest. While other Japanese equipment makers' shares fell despite meeting forecasts, Advantest raised its full-year guidance, indicating strengthening wafer fabrication equipment (WFE) demand led by DRAM and advanced logic. Morgan Stanley maintains Advantest as its top pick and also favors Tokyo Electron, anticipating upside to its second-half sales and profit.

feed.title: Costco stock eases after strong Q3 2026 earnings and expansion push
feed.summary: Costco's stock experienced a slight dip after its robust Q3 2026 earnings report, which highlighted strong double-digit sales growth and membership fee income. Despite an ambitious $6.5 billion expansion plan and continued solid fundamentals, investors are evaluating the company's high valuation. The article also notes strong analyst support and a positive long-term outlook, driven by its unique membership model and strategic growth initiatives.

feed.title: HCA Healthcare Jumps 6.0% After JP Morgan Maintains Neutral
feed.summary: HCA Healthcare shares surged 6.0% to $430.79 on Friday, despite JP Morgan cutting its price target from $490 to $425 and maintaining a Neutral rating. The unexpected rally suggests investors may be looking beyond the analyst's more conservative outlook, possibly anticipating stronger operational performance or improved industry fundamentals. This divergence highlights the complexity of market sentiment around HCA, a major hospital operator, as trading volume reached 750,059 shares.

feed.title: BWS Financial Reiterates Buy Rating for John B. Sanfilippo & Son (NASDAQ:JBSS)
feed.summary: BWS Financial has reiterated its "Buy" rating for John B. Sanfilippo & Son (NASDAQ:JBSS) and maintained a $109 price target, indicating a potential 45.7% upside from its current price of $74.80. This comes despite the company missing analyst earnings expectations for its latest quarter, reporting $0.71 per share against an estimated $1.17, although revenue exceeded estimates. Overall analyst sentiment for JBSS remains cautious, with a consensus "Hold" rating, and institutional investors own 70.64% of the company.

feed.title: Bronstein, Gewirtz & Grossman LLC Urges iTonic Holdings Ltd. f/k/a Pheton Holdings Ltd. Investors to Act: Class Action Filed Alleging Investor Harm
feed.summary: Bronstein, Gewirtz & Grossman, LLC has filed a class action lawsuit against iTonic Holdings Ltd. (NASDAQ: ITOC; previously PTHL) alleging federal securities law violations. The lawsuit claims iTonic made false and misleading statements during the Class Period (September 5, 2024, to July 29, 2025), failing to disclose an alleged market manipulation and fraudulent promotion scheme. Investors who purchased iTonic Class A ordinary shares during this period are encouraged to join the case before the lead plaintiff deadline of September 29, 2026.

feed.title: DexCom Study Demonstrates CGM Benefits in Type 2 Diabetes
feed.summary: A new study by DexCom, called CONNECT, shows that their Dexcom G7 continuous glucose monitoring (CGM) system significantly lowers A1C and improves glucose control in people with Type 2 diabetes who do not use insulin, when compared to standard self-monitoring of blood glucose. This trial involved 440 participants and demonstrated benefits across various demographics and medication regimens, suggesting that CGM could become a new standard of care for this patient group. The results highlight substantial reductions in A1C and increased time in the target glucose range for Dexcom G7 users.

feed.title: Hall of Famer Walter Jones Will Join 1,000-Pair Shoe Giveaway in Yakima
feed.summary: Coordinated Care, a subsidiary of Centene (NYSE: CNC), is launching a nine-day statewide health tour in Washington with its "SeeMore" vision van and "Flossy" dental van. The tour will provide free vision and dental screenings, prescription glasses, fluoride treatments, and dental kits, particularly targeting rural and underinvested communities. Seattle Seahawks legend Walter Jones will participate in the final stop in Yakima, where 1,000 pairs of shoes will be given away to children.

feed.title: Coordinated Care Brings Free Health Screenings to Washington Communities with Statewide Vision & Dental Van Tour
feed.summary: Coordinated Care, a subsidiary of Centene Corporation, is launching a nine-day statewide tour in Washington to offer free vision and dental screenings to communities, especially in rural areas. The initiative utilizes mobile vans, "SeeMore" and "Flossy," to provide services like prescription glasses, fluoride treatments, and health resources, irrespective of Coordinated Care membership. Seattle Seahawks legend Walter Jones will join the final stop in Yakima to distribute 1,000 free pairs of shoes to children.

feed.title: HPQ Set to Report Q3 Earnings: What's in Store for the Stock?
feed.summary: HP Inc. (HPQ) is scheduled to release its third-quarter fiscal 2026 results on August 26, with revenue estimates at $14.60 billion, a 4.8% increase year-over-year. The company's performance is expected to be boosted by its Personal Systems business, especially AI PCs and premium PCs, despite potential headwinds from rising memory prices and inflationary pressures. HPQ currently holds a Zacks Rank #3 (Hold) and an Earnings ESP of 0.00%, suggesting an uncertain outlook for an earnings beat.
